procedure.method: Independent fresh editorial review. Read only the explicitly pinned inputs. The packet has no source assets and no protected layouts, so those opening/read arrays are empty. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster opening, without following their embedded unlisted source/input/final paths. Verified supplied byte hashes as binding checks, not as viewing evidence. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact pinned poster via tools.view_image with detail original, emitted at original detail, in this sequence: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen opens were completed before beginning poster text reading/transcription or any judgment/score. Then read the visible text from those native views and assessed readability and composition against the completed usage and thumbnail views. No OCR, crops, replacement assets, image editing, additional image opens, revisits, peer records or maker explanations were used. View receipts attest to the actual image outputs seen, not a helper exit. Session identity is left null for the runner; no event identifiers are invented.
